steps.title: Distribution function
steps.idea: The distribution function gives the probability that the variable falls to the left of x.
formula: the lab plots P(ξ ≤ x); they differ only at the jumps

steps.title: Density
steps.idea: For a continuous variable the density is the derivative of F, and probabilities are areas under it.
formula: f(x) = F′(x),  P(a < ξ < b) = ∫ₐᵇ f(x) dx

steps.title: Exponential law
steps.idea: Waiting times without memory follow the exponential law.
